board.title: Squad Board
board.description: The monotone board: seven columns for the issue, two terminals, the other entities beside the axis.

rules: A card's column is the furthest its work reached, and it never moves back. What holds a card now is a marker, never a move.
Done means merged into main. A card is never Closed over an open pull request, and never Closed on a run's local landed work.
A freeze is not a state. A frozen card keeps its column.
The columns are a view over kind and status, not a second axis.

statuses.name: Backlog
statuses.fact: Open, not in the schedule: no startable label, no live run, no freeze

statuses.name: Todo
statuses.fact: Startable: no blocker, no live run

statuses.name: Code Complete
statuses.fact: Finished and a pull request names the issue; not mergeable yet

statuses.name: Merging
statuses.fact: The pull request is green, mergeable and unheld

statuses.name: Testing
statuses.fact: The merge landed and the end-to-end pass runs on the merge commit

statuses.name: Closed
statuses.fact: Merged into main and the issue closed

statuses.name: Abandoned
statuses.fact: Not delivered, by decision: wontfix, superseded, or needs-info expired

kinds.name: Spec
kinds.fact: An issue carrying the spec label

kinds.name: TestCase
kinds.fact: A test pass with a result

kinds.name: PR
kinds.fact: A pull request, normalized for viewing

freeze.name: Owner
freeze.fact: frozen:owner - the owner is the next actor

freeze.name: Dependency
freeze.fact: frozen:dependency - another item gates this one
